label: Illustration and art style
description: Non-photographic art styles across anime, illustration, comics, painting, drawing, print, graphics, 3D, and craft.
notes: Named movements and distinct visual treatments for non-photographic images belong here; art.medium owns bare physical media. Bind only when the prompt asks for drawn, painted, animated, graphic, or crafted imagery, and use family to keep draws within the requested tradition. Values retain descriptive noun phrases after in, while short names label the chooser and look explains unfamiliar terms. Historical styles remain usable in contemporary images; no artist, studio, or product names are included.
